sentences.text: The Petitioner seeks parole for a period of 60 days.

He stands convicted for life in FIR No.
248/2010, for offences under Sections 365/376(2)(G)/506/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860,
registered at P.S. Dhaula Kuan.
2. It is noted that Petitioner's application for parole dated 3rd September, 2025 is still awaiting consideration by the Competent Authorities.

Accordingly, Mr. Sanjay Lao, Standing Counsel for State, is requested to apprise the Court of the decision regarding this application before the next hearing.
3.
